title: Welcome Col. Jeffrey Glover and Greg Barbaccia | Andreessen Horowitz
gist: a16z adds Col. Jeffrey Glover (Arizona DPS director) and Greg Barbaccia (ex-US Federal CIO, ex-Palantir) as advisors to its American Dynamism and Growth practices, a staffing signal of the firm's push into public-safety, govtech, cyber and defense. Light announcement with no financial data.

insights.claim: a16z added Col. Jeffrey Glover, Director of the Arizona Department of Public Safety, as an advisor to its American Dynamism and Growth practices to guide founders building for public safety and law enforcement.
insights.speaker: David Ulevitch, David George
insights.so_what: Signals a16z is actively sourcing public-safety technology deals; watch for portfolio announcements in law-enforcement tech.

insights.claim: Greg Barbaccia, most recently U.S. Federal Chief Information Officer and a decade-plus Palantir veteran, joins a16z as an advisor across government technology, cybersecurity, defense, intelligence and digital services.
insights.speaker: David Ulevitch, David George
insights.so_what: A former federal CIO plus Palantir alumnus indicates a16z is positioning for govtech/defense procurement access; relevant to defense-tech and cyber startup pipelines.

insights.claim: a16z frames capital as only part of what startups need: founders also need leaders who understand how institutions operate, where change gets stuck, and how to turn new technology into lasting national capability.
insights.speaker: David Ulevitch, David George
insights.so_what: Venture differentiation in govtech/defense is being built on access and operator networks rather than money alone.
insights.quote: But capital is only part of what new companies need to win.

insights.claim: a16z's American Dynamism advisor network now includes General Bryan Fenton as Special Advisor and Anne Neuberger as General Partner and Head of Global Affairs, and the firm says the group will keep growing.
insights.speaker: David Ulevitch, David George
insights.so_what: Expect further senior government/defense hires; a sustained build-out suggests a durable investment focus on national-security tech.

insights.claim: a16z argues that modernizing the institutions responsible for US security, resilience and prosperity is a prerequisite for America's future, and its American Dynamism practice backs founders building companies to meet those needs at scale.
insights.speaker: David Ulevitch, David George
insights.so_what: Frames security, resilience and public-sector modernization as a multi-year venture theme.
